files.namespace:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
  name: lingo-staging
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: lingo-legacy
    environment: isolated-staging-proposal
files.deployment:
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: lingo-container-smoke
  namespace: lingo-staging
  labels:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lingo-container-smoke
    app.kubernetes.io/part-of: lingo-legacy
spec:
  replicas: 1
  revisionHistoryLimit: 2
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app.kubernetes.io/name: lingo-container-smoke
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: lingo-container-smoke
        app.kubernetes.io/part-of: lingo-legacy
    spec:
      automountServiceAccountToken: false
      terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 15
      securityContext:
        runAsNonRoot: true
        runAsUser: 1000
        runAsGroup: 1000
        seccompProfile:
          type: RuntimeDefault
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: ghcr.io/REPLACE_ME/lingo-legacy-container:REVIEW_REQUIRED
          imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent
          ports:
            - name: http
              containerPort: 8080
          env:
            - name: NODE_ENV
              value: production
            - name: HOST
              value: 0.0.0.0
            - name: PORT
              value: "8080"
          securityContext:
            allowPrivilegeEscalation: false
            readOnlyRootFilesystem: true
            capabilities:
              drop: ["ALL"]
          resources:
            requests:
              cpu: 50m
              memory: 64Mi
            limits:
              cpu: 250m
              memory: 128Mi
          startupProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 5
            failureThreshold: 12
          readinessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 10
          livenessProbe:
            httpGet:
              path: /healthz
              port: http
            periodSeconds: 20
files.service:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: lingo-container-smoke
  namespace: lingo-staging
spec:
  type: ClusterIP
  selector:
    app.kubernetes.io/name: lingo-container-smoke
  ports:
    - name: http
      port: 8080
      targetPort: http
files.kustomization:
apiVersion: kustomize.config.k8s.io/v1beta1
kind: Kustomization
namespace: lingo-staging
resources:
  - namespace.yaml
  - deployment.yaml
  - service.yaml
files.dockerfile:
# Proposal-only scaffold: not the canonical Cloudflare Worker runtime.
# Pin this base image to an approved digest before any release build.
FROM node:22-alpine AS runtime
ENV NODE_ENV=production
WORKDIR /app

# Docker build context is containers/; copy only the standalone health service.
COPY --chown=node:node server.mjs ./server.mjs

USER node
EXPOSE 8080
HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=3s --start-period=5s --retries=3 \
  CMD node -e "fetch('http://127.0.0.1:8080/healthz').then(r=>process.exit(r.ok?0:1)).catch(()=>process.exit(1))"
CMD ["node", "server.mjs"]
files.dockerignore:
# Build context is containers/: allowlist only required runtime inputs.
**
!Dockerfile
!server.mjs
files.compose:
services:
  lingo-container-smoke:
    build:
      context: .
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image: lingo-legacy-container:local
    environment:
      NODE_ENV: production
      HOST: 0.0.0.0
      PORT: "8080"
    ports:
      - "127.0.0.1:8080:8080"
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
      - /tmp:size=16m,noexec,nosuid
    cap_drop:
      - ALL
    security_opt:
      - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: "no"
